messages:
kayla: FYI docs PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2021 is blocked. I'm documenting Dedicated pool defaults and included `max_concurrent_streams: 8` as the default shown in Console. QA found canary failing when we run with the literal docs example - runtime only allows 4 streams on our test cluster. Need eng confirmation on what to say in docs before merging. cc @tom @nina

 tom: got it. can you paste the yaml snippet you used in the example?

 kayla: sure:
 ```yaml
 dedicated:
   pool: small-gpu-pool
   autoscale: false
   max_concurrent_streams: 8
 ```
 in Console the UI shows 8 as the "recommended" value but runtime rejected 8 on the canary cluster with error: `pool capacity exceeded: max streams 4`.

 nina: quick context: historically the runtime default max_concurrent_streams was 4 for older cluster agent versions. newer agent/driver releases bump the default presentation in Console to 8, but cluster-level enforcement remains 4 until agents are upgraded. So behavior depends on agent version.

 kayla: oh that explains it. Docs currently say "Default: 8 (recommended)" which is wrong for older clusters. We should avoid asserting a single numeric default.

 alan: from QA side, tests fail when example uses 8 on our staging clusters (they're on agent v1.3). We can either change the example to explicitly set 4 or make docs recommend explicitly setting the value.

 tom: eng-platform opinion: we shouldn't hardcode a number as the universal default. Suggest wording: "If unspecified, the enforced limit depends on cluster agent version; set max_concurrent_streams explicitly to ensure predictable behavior." Also add a note with compatibility table linking to the release notes.

 nina: agree. i'll open a tiny PR to runtime that will document the agent versions and target default; but that's separate. For the docs PR we should change the example to show an explicit value and call out upgrade behavior.

 kayla: proposed change: update example to `max_concurrent_streams: 4` and add a short callout: "Note: older cluster agents may enforce a lower limit; to avoid surprises, set this field explicitly or upgrade agents." Thoughts?

 alan: LGTM. that fixes the QA flakes.

 tom: SGTM. add a link to the agent compatibility doc and i'll sign off.

 kayla: thanks. i'll push an amend with the explicit 4 in the example + compatibility note and link. request review from @nina @tom when done.

 merge-bot: Merge hold applied by docs-protect (reason: dedicated-defaults-runtime-compat)

 nina: will review once the amend is up. thanks for catching this, kayla.

 kayla: pushing the update now, will ping thread when CI preview completes :rocket:
